source_row.rationale: Basophils, though normally the least abundant white blood cell type, play a role in allergic and inflammatory responses, releasing substances such as histamine and other mediators, contributing to processes involved in conditions like allergic reactions and certain inflammatory states.
source_row.source_detail: General Role of Basophils in Immune Response
